ev.q: This report presents the first analysis of WHO-UNICEF Joint Reporting Form data that estimates worldwide HepB vaccine birth dose coverage.
Worldwide, 27% of newborns received a HepB vaccine birth dose in 2006.
Birth dose coverage worldwide was 27% and varied widely by region, from 3% to 71%
Birth dose coverage for countries with > 8% chronic HBV infection prevalence was 36%
Since 1998, WHO and UNICEF have used the Joint Reporting Form to collect information annually from WHO member states

methods_quotes.q: Global and regional HepB vaccine birth dose coverage were calculated using reported coverage figures from the Joint Reporting Form
In this analysis, countries that did not report birth dose coverage on the Joint Reporting Form were assumed to have 0% birth dose coverage.
